lines.says: Assume a bundle of seven background statements that the code calls Hypotheses₂, and then take any real number eps, any family record Fm of type FamP eps, any real number C and any natural number CT. If 0 ≤ C, and Fm satisfies the condition TwGood, the condition FactsFAlt with the constants C and CT, and the condition BoundAtTwoThreeFamilyFonAlt, then Fm satisfies ConclF. The dossier unfolds ConclF to the claim that real numbers C′ and x0 exist such that, for every real x ≥ x0 with Fm.x1 < x and every index i in Fm.Ix x, if the data record Fm.D x i satisfies ShaFinOdd then a record X of type HubData exists for which a fifteen-part condition that the code calls Concl holds for the size record Fm.L x i, the parameter record that Fm.params gives at x and i, the record X and the constant C′.
premises: The bundle Hypotheses₂ holds, which is assumed before eps, Fm, C and CT are chosen and which consists of seven named statements.
The real number C satisfies 0 ≤ C.

Fm satisfies TwGood, which unfolds to the existence of a real x0 such that for every x ≥ x0 with Fm.x1 < x and every index i a condition that the code calls TwConjAt holds and some N0 and S make a condition that the code calls TwGoodAt hold.

Fm satisfies FactsFAlt with C and CT, which says that for every x with Fm.x1 < x and every index i the data record Fm.D x i satisfies a bundle that the code calls NormChoiceFacts and a condition that the code calls ExtraAlt with C and CT.

Fm satisfies BoundAtTwoThreeFamilyFonAlt, which says that real numbers C″ and x0 exist such that for every x ≥ x0 with Fm.x1 < x, every index i and every choice of data HW, F, a comparison datum, a HubData record X and a real C₂, the bundle SetupAlt for these data implies the condition BoundAtTwoThree for Fm.L x i, the component ρ of X and C″.
lines.conclusion: Fm satisfies ConclF, which says that real numbers C′ and x0 exist such that for every x ≥ x0 with Fm.x1 < x and every index i, ShaFinOdd for Fm.D x i implies that a HubData record X exists with Concl for Fm.L x i, Fm.params at x and i, X and C′.
lines.notation: Hypotheses₂ ⇒ ∀ eps ∈ ℝ ∀ Fm ∈ FamP(eps) ∀ C ∈ ℝ ∀ CT ∈ ℕ ( (0 ≤ C ∧ TwGood(Fm) ∧ FactsFAlt(Fm, C, CT) ∧ BoundAtTwoThreeFamilyFonAlt(Fm)) ⇒ ConclF(Fm) ), where hx denotes a proof of Fm.x1 < x, i ranges over Fm.Ix(x), D = Fm.D x i, S = Fm.L x i, nch = (Fm.ex x hx i).nch, and TwGood(Fm) ⇔ ∃ x0 ∈ ℝ ∀ x ≥ x0 ∀ hx ∀ i ( TwConjAt(D, nch) ∧ ∃ N0 ∃ T TwGoodAt(D, nch, ⟨twE(Fm, x, hx, i), N0, T⟩) ), FactsFAlt(Fm, C, CT) ⇔ ∀ x ∈ ℝ ∀ hx ∀ i ( NormChoiceFacts(D, nch) ∧ ExtraAlt(D, C, CT) ), BoundAtTwoThreeFamilyFonAlt(Fm) ⇔ ∃ C″, x0 ∈ ℝ ∀ x ≥ x0 ∀ hx ∀ i ∀ HW ∀ F ∀ cmp ∀ X ∈ HubData(D) ∀ C₂ ∈ ℝ ( SetupAlt(S, nch, HW, X, C₂) ⇒ BoundAtTwoThree(S, X.ρ, C″) ), ConclF(Fm) ⇔ ∃ C′, x0 ∈ ℝ ∀ x ≥ x0 ∀ hx ∀ i ( ShaFinOdd(D) ⇒ ∃ X ∈ HubData(D) Concl(S, Fm.params x hx i, X, C′) )

terms.name: Hypotheses₂
terms.gloss: A bundle of seven statements under the field names font, artin, bk, tate, euler, fin and bs, whose contents are the names FontaineBcris, GlobalArtinReciprocity, BlochKatoLocal, LocalTateDualityK, LocalEulerCharK, LocalFinitenessK and BhattScholzeIntegral, and the dossier shows a body for LocalEulerCharK and LocalFinitenessK only.

terms.name: LocalEulerCharK
terms.gloss: The statement that for every prime l, every field K between the l-adic numbers and a field that the code calls PadicAlgCl l with finite dimension n over the l-adic numbers, every whole number r > 0, every finite module M over the integers modulo l^r with the discrete topology and every representation rho on M of a group that the code calls GK l K with a condition called ContAction, the number of elements of H1 rho equals the number of elements of H0 rho times the number of elements of H2 rho times the n-th power of the number of elements of M, where H0, H1, H2, GK, PadicAlgCl and ContAction have no body in the dossier.

terms.name: LocalFinitenessK
terms.gloss: The statement, under the same quantifiers and conditions as LocalEulerCharK, that H0 rho, H1 rho and H2 rho are finite and that Hn rho n has at most one element for every n ≥ 3, where H0, H1, H2 and Hn have no body in the dossier.

terms.name: FamP
terms.gloss: A record type that depends on a real number eps and extends a record FamCore, which holds a threshold x1 > 1, an index type Ix x for each real x, a data record D x i of type D7 and a size record L x i for each x and each index i, and FamP adds many further fields such as params and ex, whose listing the dossier cuts.

terms.name: D7
terms.gloss: A large data record with fields such as R of a type called Ranks, host, sp, vol, what₂ and a number field what₂.LL that is totally complex and Galois over the rational numbers, and the dossier cuts its listing.

terms.name: TwGood
terms.gloss: TwGood Fm is defined as TwGoodE applied to Fm and to twE Fm, and the dossier shows both TwGoodE and twE one level down.

terms.name: TwGoodE
terms.gloss: TwGoodE Fm E says that a real x0 exists such that for every x ≥ x0 with Fm.x1 < x and every index i, the condition TwConjAt holds for Fm.D x i and the component nch of the Extra record of Fm at x and i, and a function N0 into the natural numbers and a family S of finite sets exist for which TwGoodAt holds for the triple made of E at x and i, N0 and S, where TwConjAt and TwGoodAt have no body in the dossier.

terms.name: twE
terms.gloss: twE Fm assigns to x and i the value of a function called twEOf at the component xd of the Extra record of Fm at x and i, and twEOf has no body in the dossier.

terms.name: FactsFAlt
terms.gloss: FactsFAlt Fm C CT says that for every real x with Fm.x1 < x and every index i in Fm.Ix x, NormChoiceFacts holds for Fm.D x i and the component nch of the Extra record of Fm at x and i, and ExtraAlt holds for Fm.D x i, C and CT.

terms.name: NormChoiceFacts
terms.gloss: A bundle that extends a bundle called CoreNormFacts and adds seven conditions named LocalisationUniqueness, Large, Duties, NChTie, TriplesGood, SameTwist and GoodFTAll, none of which has a body in the dossier.

terms.name: ExtraAlt
terms.gloss: The conjunction of a condition on D that the code calls CommutingEndomorphismCondition and a condition on D, C and CT that the code calls PairedCharacterConditionAlt, neither of which has a body in the dossier.

terms.name: BoundAtTwoThreeFamilyFonAlt
terms.gloss: The statement that real numbers C″ and x0 exist such that for every x ≥ x0 with Fm.x1 < x, every index i, every HW of type HWOf, every F of type FonOf, every element of type CmpOf, every HubData record X and every real C₂, SetupAlt for Fm.L x i, the component nch, HW, X and C₂ implies BoundAtTwoThree for Fm.L x i, the component ρ of X and C″.

terms.name: HWOf
terms.gloss: HWOf L is the type of choices, for every prime l, of an element of a type that the code calls LocHW l (L l), which has no body in the dossier.

terms.name: FonOf
terms.gloss: FonOf L A H is the type of choices, for every prime l, of an element of a type that the code calls LocFon l (L l) (A l) (H l), which has no body in the dossier.

terms.name: CmpOf
terms.gloss: CmpOf L A H F is the type of choices, for every prime l, of an element of a type that the code calls LocCmpT l (L l) (A l) (H l) (F l), which has no body in the dossier.

terms.name: SetupAlt
terms.gloss: A bundle of eight conditions, namely NormChoiceFacts, a condition called Canon that involves C₂, conditions called AdmPar and ParametersPolynomiallyBounded, the inequality 8 ≤ L.sc.L, the inequality 60 ≤ D.host.splitBound, a condition called KillAt on the component ρ of X, and ShaFinOdd for D, where Canon, AdmPar, ParametersPolynomiallyBounded and KillAt have no body in the dossier.

terms.name: BoundAtTwoThree
terms.gloss: BoundAtTwoThree L ρ C says that for every index i that satisfies a condition called TwLoc and whose number D.nd.l i equals 2, or equals 3 while lying outside the set D.host.small, and for every π in the set D.nd.Zgood i, a condition called Bd holds for ρ, i, π and the value midF L C, where TwLoc, Bd and midF have no body in the dossier.

terms.name: ConclF
terms.gloss: The statement that real numbers C′ and x0 exist such that for every x ≥ x0 with Fm.x1 < x and every index i, ShaFinOdd for Fm.D x i implies that a HubData record X exists for which Concl holds for Fm.L x i, Fm.params at x and i, X and C′.

terms.name: ShaFinOdd
terms.gloss: ShaFinOdd D says that for every prime p and every whole number e with 0 < e < t, where t is the number D.R.t stored in D, the value shaLen (D.nd.ldat p) e differs from the top element ⊤ of its range, and shaLen has no body in the dossier.

terms.name: HubData
terms.gloss: A record attached to a data record D with fourteen fields, among them r, ρ, len0, errorBoundHub, a finite set exc of natural numbers and a natural number eta, and the types RFam, RhoFam, Decl and TwIn of several fields have no body in the dossier.

terms.name: Concl
terms.gloss: A bundle of fifteen conditions on L, P, X and C, the first of which is 0 ≤ C and the other fourteen of which are conditions under the names adm1, MultLe, adm3, KillAt, RowNum, StarAD, BBLe, StarE, ExcOK, StarF, StarG, StarH, ParametersPolynomiallyBounded and Small, none of which has a body in the dossier.

terms.name: conclF_of_family_facts_and_bound_at_two_three
terms.gloss: A second theorem, in the namespace GlobalTheory.T, whose statement is word for word the same as that of main_alt_alt and which the dossier folds into this line as a wrapper.

lines.suggests: The names suggest that Hypotheses₂ gathers published theorems (Fontaine's theory of B_cris, global Artin reciprocity, the Bloch–Kato local conditions, local Tate duality, the local Euler characteristic formula, finiteness of local Galois cohomology and an integral result of Bhatt and Scholze), that H0, H1 and H2 are cohomology groups of a local Galois group GK, that ShaFinOdd expresses finiteness of Tate–Shafarevich-type groups, and that BoundAtTwoThree is a bound at the primes 2 and 3, and the dossier leaves each of these readings unconfirmed.
lines.why: The dossier shows the whole logical skeleton of the statement, of its four conditions on Fm and of ConclF, yet nearly every condition inside them ends in a name without a shown body, the listings of FamP and D7 are cut, and five definitions were left out.

second.says: Assume first the bundle of seven propositions that the code calls Hypotheses₂, and then take any real number eps, any family Fm of type FamP eps, any real number C and any natural number CT. If 0 ≤ C, TwGood Fm, FactsFAlt Fm C CT and BoundAtTwoThreeFamilyFonAlt Fm all hold, then ConclF Fm holds, which says that there exist real numbers C and x0, new ones that are separate from the C of the theorem, such that for every x ≥ x0, every proof hx that Fm.x1 < x and every index i in Fm.Ix x, the condition ShaFinOdd (Fm.D x i) implies that there exists hub data X of type HubData (Fm.D x i) for which the structure Concl (Fm.L x i) (Fm.params x hx i) X C holds. The wrapper theorem conclF_of_family_facts_and_bound_at_two_three that the dossier folds into this line has the same statement word for word.
premises: Hypotheses₂ holds, and this premise stands before the quantifiers over eps, Fm, C and CT. It is a structure of seven propositions with the fields font (FontaineBcris), artin (GlobalArtinReciprocity), bk (BlochKatoLocal), tate (LocalTateDualityK), euler (LocalEulerCharK), fin (LocalFinitenessK) and bs (BhattScholzeIntegral). The dossier shows a body for euler and fin only. LocalEulerCharK says that for every prime l, every intermediate field K between ℚ_[l] and PadicAlgCl l that is finite dimensional over ℚ_[l], every natural r, every finite discrete module M over ZMod (l ^ r) and every representation rho of GK l K on M with 0 < r and ContAction rho, the cardinality of H1 rho equals the cardinality of H0 rho times the cardinality of H2 rho times the cardinality of M raised to the power finrank of K over ℚ_[l]. LocalFinitenessK says under the same assumptions that H0 rho, H1 rho and H2 rho are finite and that Hn rho n is a subsingleton for every n with 3 ≤ n.
0 ≤ C holds for the real number C.

TwGood Fm holds, which is defined as TwGoodE Fm (twE Fm). It says that there is a real x0 such that for every x ≥ x0, every proof hx that Fm.x1 < x and every i in Fm.Ix x, a condition that the code calls TwConjAt holds for Fm.D x i and (Fm.ex x hx i).nch, and there exist a function N0 into the natural numbers and a family of finite sets S such that a condition that the code calls TwGoodAt holds for Fm.D x i, (Fm.ex x hx i).nch and the triple made of twE Fm x hx i, N0 and S. Here twE Fm x hx i is twEOf (Fm.ex x hx i).xd.

FactsFAlt Fm C CT holds, which says that for every real x, every proof hx that Fm.x1 < x and every i in Fm.Ix x, both NormChoiceFacts (Fm.D x i) (Fm.ex x hx i).nch and ExtraAlt (Fm.D x i) C CT hold. NormChoiceFacts D nch extends a structure that the code calls CoreNormFacts D and adds the fields c2 (LocalisationUniqueness D), large (CoefDuty.Large D), duties (CoefDuty.Duties D), nct (NChTie D nch), trip (PtCore.TriplesGood D), same (PtCore.SameTwist D nch) and good (GoodFTAll D). ExtraAlt D C CT is the conjunction of CommutingEndomorphismCondition D and PairedCharacterConditionAlt for D with C and CT.

BoundAtTwoThreeFamilyFonAlt Fm holds, which says that there exist reals C and x0, separate from the C of the theorem, such that for every x ≥ x0, every proof hx that Fm.x1 < x, every i in Fm.Ix x, every HW of type HWOf (Fm.D x i).loc, every F of type FonOf (Fm.D x i).loc (Fm.D x i).locA HW, every element of CmpOf (Fm.D x i).loc (Fm.D x i).locA HW F, every hub data X for Fm.D x i and every real C₂, SetupAlt (Fm.L x i) (Fm.ex x hx i).nch HW X C₂ implies BoundAtTwoThree (Fm.L x i) X.ρ C. SetupAlt L nch HW X C₂ is a structure with the fields facts (NormChoiceFacts D nch), canon (HubX.Canon L HW (rowC C₂) X), par (AdmPar L), par67 (EmbeddingTypeJumps.ParametersPolynomiallyBounded L), big (8 ≤ L.sc.L), split (60 ≤ D.host.splitBound), kill (KillAt X.ρ) and sha (ShaFinOdd D). BoundAtTwoThree L ρ C says that for every i with TwLoc D i and with either D.nd.l i = 2 or both D.nd.l i = 3 and D.nd.l i not in D.host.small, every π in D.nd.Zgood i satisfies Bd ρ i π (midF L C).
second.conclusion: ConclF Fm holds, that is there exist reals C and x0 such that for every x ≥ x0, every proof hx that Fm.x1 < x and every i in Fm.Ix x, ShaFinOdd (Fm.D x i) implies that some X of type HubData (Fm.D x i) satisfies Concl (Fm.L x i) (Fm.params x hx i) X C. ShaFinOdd D says that for every prime p and every natural e with 0 < e and e < D.R.t the value shaLen (D.nd.ldat p) e, with e read as an integer, is not ⊤. Concl L P X C is a structure with the fifteen fields pos (0 ≤ C), pass (adm1 D), mult (MultLe L), rank (adm3 L), kill (KillAt X.ρ), num (RowNum L X C), mid (StarAD L X), bb (BBLe L X C), large (StarE L X.ρ X.exc), exc (ExcOK L X.exc), two (StarF L X.ρ C), ram (StarG L X.ρ C), typ (StarH L C), par (TwistedPlaces.ParametersPolynomiallyBounded L C P) and small (Small L C).

terms.name: Green
terms.gloss: A proposition shown in full, which says that for every prime g, every L of type LabelDatum g and every integer d > 0 there is a map τ from polynomials over the integers modulo g to complex-valued functions on GL_d of the integers modulo g such that every P with IsPrimeLab d P has IsCuspOf L P (τ P) and has τ P at the identity matrix equal to the product of g^i − 1 over i from 1 to d − 1, such that τ P = τ P' forces P = P' for two such polynomials, and such that every function χ with IsCusp χ equals τ P for some such P.

terms.name: Gn
terms.gloss: Gn g n is the group GL (Fin n) (ZMod g) of invertible n by n matrices with entries in the integers modulo g.

terms.name: LabelDatum
terms.gloss: A type that depends on g and whose definition the dossier does not show.

terms.name: IsPrimeLab
terms.gloss: A condition on an integer d and a polynomial P over the integers modulo g, used in Green and not shown.

terms.name: IsCuspOf
terms.gloss: A condition on a label datum L, a polynomial P and a complex-valued function on GL_d, used in Green and not shown.

terms.name: IsCusp
terms.gloss: A condition on a complex-valued function on GL_d of the integers modulo g, used in Green and not shown.

terms.name: TopShapeAlt
terms.gloss: A proposition with four slots V, NR, N and G, shown in full, which says that for every family class 𝒜, every function cT and 51 further bound items of data and hypotheses, including a proof of V, a proof of NR and a proof of N applied to D3 3 𝒜, the proposition in the slot G holds.

terms.name: FamClass
terms.gloss: A family class is a predicate that gives a truth value to every Fm of type FamP eps, for every real eps.

terms.name: FamP
terms.gloss: A record type that depends on a real eps, extends a record FamCore that is not shown and is itself shown only in part, with visible fields such as lists of real constants PK and PT, real constants CTu, Csz and Cr with 1 ≤ Cr, and many fields indexed by a real x above a threshold x1 and an index i in Ix x.

terms.name: FamCore
terms.gloss: The record that FamP extends, not shown, which by the way the text uses it must supply the real x1, the index types Ix x and the objects D x i and L x i.

terms.name: selected point
terms.gloss: My shorthand, not a Lean name, for the block of quantifiers that recurs in TopShapeAlt and ranges over every real eps, every family Fm in FamP eps, every proof hc of 𝒜 Fm, every real x with Fm.x1 < x and (sel Fm hc).1 ≤ x, and every index i in Fm.Ix x.

terms.name: Closed
terms.gloss: Closed 𝒞 P says that there is a real ε1 > 0 such that for every real eps with 0 < eps ≤ ε1 there is a K of type TransportedAlt such that P Fm CH holds for every Fm in FamP eps and every real CH with 𝒞 Fm and Fm.Large K CH.

terms.name: TransportedAlt
terms.gloss: A record made of one real number pre and three functions t, mid and last from finite lists of reals to reals.

terms.name: Large
terms.gloss: A condition Fm.Large K CH on a family, a TransportedAlt record and a real number, whose definition the dossier does not show.

terms.name: LinkN
terms.gloss: LinkN Fm says that there are reals C and x0 such that for every real x ≥ x0, every index i in Fm.Ix x with ShaFinOdd (Fm.D x i) and every integer j from 1 to (Fm.D x i).R.m, the condition LinkN_at (Fm.L x i) j C holds.

terms.name: LinkN_at
terms.gloss: LinkN_at L j C says that if the series of the terms vvTerm D l over l is summable, then etaSum L j ≤ L.dZ0 j · (C · (D.R.f · D.R.m · L.sc.b · (L.sc.L)² + (log L.sc.x)² · L.Nc) + the sum of that series).

terms.name: etaSum
terms.gloss: A real quantity etaSum L j on the left of the inequality in LinkN_at, not shown.

terms.name: vvTerm
terms.gloss: A sequence of terms vvTerm D l whose infinite sum enters LinkN_at, not shown.

terms.name: ShaFinOdd
terms.gloss: ShaFinOdd D says that for every prime p, with no restriction to odd primes visible in the body, and every integer e with 0 < e < D.R.t, the value shaLen (D.nd.ldat p) e differs from ⊤, the top element of its value type.

terms.name: shaLen
terms.gloss: A function of a datum D.nd.ldat p and an integer e whose values are compared with a top element ⊤, not shown.

terms.name: lifts
terms.gloss: lifts D is the finite set of the integers from 1 to D.R.m.

terms.name: D7
terms.gloss: The type of the objects D x i, shown without a definition, of which the text uses fields such as R.m, R.f, R.t, R.k, R.r, what₂, mem, host and div.

terms.name: SizeData₂
terms.gloss: The type of the objects L x i attached to a D of type D7, shown without a definition, of which the text uses fields such as sc, supp, dZ0, Nc and etaSz.

terms.name: TopG
terms.gloss: TopG says that for every real la and every G of type FReq, if 1 < la, if HostExW la G.req holds and if every Fm of every FamP eps with G.cls la Fm satisfies HypV Fm.toFamCore, then FamilyClassConnected (G.cls la) holds.

terms.name: FReq
terms.gloss: A type, not shown, whose elements G carry a field G.req and a field G.cls that turns a real la into a family class.

terms.name: HostExW
terms.gloss: A condition on a real la and on G.req, used in TopG and in ExS and not shown.

terms.name: HypV
terms.gloss: A condition on the FamCore part of a family, used in TopG and not shown.

terms.name: FamilyClassConnected
terms.gloss: A condition on a family class that forms the final conclusion of TopG and is not shown.

terms.name: D3
terms.gloss: D3 C0 𝒜 is the family class Des (WithChN 𝒜) C0, so D3 3 𝒜 is Des (WithChN 𝒜) 3.

terms.name: Des
terms.gloss: An operation that turns a family class and a real constant into a family class, not shown.

terms.name: d3_a
terms.gloss: A map, not shown, that the text applies to a proof of D3 3 𝒜 Fm in places where a proof of 𝒜 Fm is required.

terms.gloss: WithChN 𝒞 is the class of the families Fm with 𝒞 Fm, DGamDvdF Fm, TameDistinctF Fm, BoxesF Fm, QDRowsF Fm and Fm.CYL ≤ 9, where the four named conditions are not shown.

terms.name: WithSm
terms.gloss: WithSm 𝒞 is the class of the families Fm with 𝒞 Fm and DGamSmooth Fm, where DGamSmooth is not shown.

terms.name: WithTw
terms.gloss: WithTw 𝒞 is the class of the families Fm with 𝒞 Fm and TwGood Fm, where TwGood is not shown.

terms.name: MinkDiv
terms.gloss: MinkDiv says that MinkMult n (minkM n) holds for every natural number n, where MinkMult and minkM are not shown.

terms.name: DesignChoices
terms.gloss: A condition on a family class, a constant and a function of two reals, used in ExS and not shown.

terms.name: Duty

terms.name: TwistSelectionFunctions
